# Generated by `cargo xtask symbols`; do not edit. One line per exported runtime function:
# `name(param: type, ..) -> ret`, the C signature lowering marshals runtime calls from, then the
# flags the source declares with a `// ms: leaf pure fresh` comment above the function:
# `@leaf` never reaches a cancellation point, `@pure` only reads memory and cannot fault,
# `@fresh` returns a value that borrows none of its arguments, `@keeps:<param>` stores that
# function value, `@takes:<param>` takes ownership of that value, `@spawns` starts a task
# running program code, `@takes_self` has a `<name>_take` twin that reuses its first
# argument when it dies at the call, `@op=<mnemonic>` is exactly that MIR instruction on
# its arguments, and `@domain=<words>` names its failures' domain.
